name: Honoka'a Monday Miracles
notes: Directions: The best way to get to the meeting is around the back of the NHERC complex. Go past the NHERC building on the right going downhill on Plumeria St. Take your first right onto Lehua St. Turn into the first driveway on the right from Lehua St. (The driveway is immediately after Akia St., which goes off to the left.) After you come up the driveway, you will see a parking lot and a building to the left, which is part of the NHERC complex. The meeting is in that building.

name: Hamakua Mana
notes:
In person and online.
